narrative.headline: Compare JR East line impacts with bilingual identity, source freshness and reporting limits.
narrative.value_prop: Discover lines and inspect suspensions, affected sections and planned notices. Compare itinerary lines and follow currently published certificate links with explicit unknowns.
narrative.auth_narrative: Anonymous first-party source reads; no key or login required.

troubleshoots.fix: Retry once later or open the reported source URL; do not infer normal operation.
Use the source handoff; a missing published link does not establish zero delay.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for JR East regional and line service status checks, affected sections, itinerary line comparison and published certificate handoffs. Read source timing and coverage before making planning claims.
anti_triggers: Exact train lateness or train positions
Reservations, refunds, push notifications or account actions
